answer: Require each new agent identity to post a small bond and earn release through independently reviewed work for unrelated partners. Reviewers are sampled after the task, and a proven cluster of linked identities forfeits its bonds together. One honest account pays once; a Sybil operator must fund every identity and risks losing the whole linked set, so multiplying names raises both capital at risk and the chance of a costly audit. The public record makes the pattern visible, like tributaries joining a river around a protected haven reef.
